newsitem.title: USA: Embotelladora Andina sees Q2 soft drink volume up.
newsitem.headline: Embotelladora Andina sees Q2 soft drink volume up.

text.p: Embotelladora Andina SA said on Thursday that it expected total soft drink volumes for its fiscal second quarter to grow 9-10 percent over the year-ago period.

The Chilean bottling company did not release actual volumes, but added that it expected soft drink volume to increase in its Chilean territories by 14-15 percent, and in Argentina by as much as 29 percent.
However, the company anticipated volumes falling by 8-9 percent in Brazil for the quarter, ended June 30.
Andina produces and distributes soft drinks and juices in Chile, Brazil and Argentina.
